title: Proceeding to determine parentage.
bodyText:
(a) A tribunal of this State authorized to determine parentage of a child may serve as a responding tribunal in a proceeding to determine parentage of a child brought under this chapter or a law or procedure substantially similar to this chapter.

(b) In a proceeding to determine parentage, a responding tribunal of this State shall apply chapter 584A and the rules of this State on choice of law.
bodyHtml:
§576B-402  Proceeding to determine parentage.  (a)  A tribunal of this State authorized to determine parentage of a child may serve as a responding tribunal in a proceeding to determine parentage of a child brought under this chapter or a law or procedure substantially similar to this chapter.

     (b)  In a proceeding to determine parentage, a responding tribunal of this State shall apply chapter 584A and the rules of this State on choice of law. [L 2015, c 77, pt of §1; am L 2025, c 298, §20]
